comments.text: So far, still my favorite from the old works of Touhou. She has been very interesting with her four interactions between the playable characters. Rather polite for a demon with a hint of sinister when she opens her eyes, and her seeming return in the fourth stage under a blue form makes her interesting in an already quite interesting game. She's a character I would love to see return in the modern day because of the potential she has, and is often overshadowed by more popular picks.
